notes: ERC1967Proxy runtime (solc 0.8.19, 136 bytes, 14-line text). The ABI has only fallback and receive, both payable, both _fallback -> _delegate(_implementation()); the text's single payable _fallback (which also serves empty calldata, i.e. receive) delegates call.data[0 len calldata.size] to the EIP-1967 implementation slot 0x3608...2bbc, reverts with the return data on failure and returns it otherwise: exact. The slot prints as stor3608; with no getter it could still be named from the well-known EIP-1967 implementation slot (it is named implementation in c00023, where a getter exists).
summary: Exact decompilation of a minimal ERC1967 proxy fallback; nothing to report.
